title: Artaphernes
summary: Raleigh names Artaphernes in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Artaphernes, also printed Artophernes, a sonne of Hystaspes, and Lieutenant for Darius in Sardis. The printed spellings were left as one man. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter V, §. I, sig. 405a
